name: Streaming Model for Acceleration
aliases: Streaming Model Based Volume Ray Casting
definition: A heterogeneous execution model where the PPE handles empty space skipping via hierarchical traversal and the SPEs handle early ray termination during rendering.
summary: The Streaming Model for Acceleration is a parallel volume ray casting implementation for the Cell B.E. that separates traversal to the PPE and rendering to the SPEs to overlap computation and hide latency.
